K-225.instruction: Dra ett streck från varje ord till rätt bild.

K-229.instruction: Ringa in varje bokstav som är likadan som den i rutan.

K-213.instruction: Dra ett streck från varje yrkesperson till verktyget hen använder.

notes: Swedish strings were overall high quality and idiomatic; most needed no change. Three genuine fixes: (1) K-225 — 'bilden det betyder' is unidiomatic (a picture doesn't 'mean' a word). Changed to 'rätt bild', which is the natural classroom phrasing and parallels the EN 'the picture it names'. (2) K-229 — 'är lika med' is a mathematical/equality register; for matching identical letters a Swedish teacher says 'är likadan som'. (3) K-213 — number-agreement error: subject is singular 'yrkesperson' but 'de använder' is plural. Corrected to singular 'hen använder' (gender-neutral, current SV school register). Reviewed but kept as correct: 'fattas' (child-friendly, fine alongside 'saknas'); 'kroppshölje' (G1-205, accurate SV NO-term); 'Lantbruksdjur'/'Bondgårdsdjur' — 'Lantbruksdjur' kept (correct, slightly formal but acceptable); all family names, skill texts, slugs (lowercase/hyphenated/å→a ä→a ö→o correct), categoryLabels, vcLabels (Vokaler/Konsonanter) and all science binLabels (Däggdjur, Fåglar, Reptiler, Päls, Fjädrar, Fjäll, Spannmål, Växtätare, Köttätare, etc.) are accurate and natural.
